result.keywords: This study examines malware detection in embedded firmware and concurrent SoC environments by combining instruction-level abstraction with hybrid gram feature extraction. A semantic segmentation approach is applied to overlapping API-call and instruction subsequences to improve classification of obfuscated malicious behavior, using cross-entropy-guided sequence windows and comparisons against fixed-length n-gram baselines.
result.title: Hybrid Instruction Segmentation for Firmware Malicious Behavior Detection with Overlapping Gram Features
